launches.body:
Hi! We are Jochen and Vincent, co-founders of [sitefire.ai](http://sitefire.ai)! 🔥

**TL;DR:** Unlike other GEO tools, sitefire actually tells you how to improve your AI visibility. It recommends actions, and takes them for you. We are already working with Europe’s largest brands such as BMW, Xtrackers, and DWS.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rqUyyeYcoV0>

### What we are building

Unlike other GEO tools, **sitefire actually tells you how to improve your AI visibility**. sitefire analyzes AI answers (query fan-out, sourced pages, cited pages) to identify which content works. Based on this, sitefire tells you which third-party sites to reach out to and which UGC content (Youtube, Reddit, etc.) to engage with.

Second, sitefire synthesizes the **top-cited web pages** and **writes brand-aware, AI-optimized blog posts for you** **- directly delivered to your CMS**. You just publish, improve your AI visibility, and start winning leads.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97707&key=user_uploads/2979444/a9370216-c966-424c-b98b-f93707e7a04e)

### The Team

Vincent and Jochen met at Technical University of Munich (TUM). Vincent founded his first company at 18, and studied at CDTM (study program producing 20% of German unicorns). Jochen is a valedictorian of Germany’s no. 1 finance program, worked on optimization/deep RL at Stanford and as a PhD Candidate at TUM. We’re excited to bring cutting-edge data science to marketing teams!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97707&key=user_uploads/2979444/5f3cdf2b-ea74-4b34-9219-c1bfa08dc5bf)

### Our Ask

1. **Introductions:** Do you know **marketing/growth teams at Series A+ companies** that need a GEO tool to actually take action? We’d love to hear from you!
2. **Try it 🔥** : **7-day free trial at [sitefire.ai](http://sitefire.ai).** Set up your account in 5min, and get your first AI-optimized content briefing!
3. **Feedback:** Tell us what you think about our website, product, UX, etc.
